_source: The 3 parts of the current offer (Notion 'Surven offer (MASTER)' 3dce1c3d79d88063b203d0934e721836, as summed up in the Answer Bank 'Offer (high level)', 11/2): families who are only yours (ads, scripts, videos), families who act now (an offer with a deadline), families who can pay (plain questions first). Plus the follow-up that comes with every plan: an instant text from the home's own number and a morning who-to-call list with drafts. Rules: no price, no promise of results, and never say Surven calls the families (that depends on the plan they buy). When the offer changes, change this file and run the plan tests.
title: A one-page plan for {home}
intro: You asked for this plan. Here is what we would set up for {home} in your first 90 days.

steps.title: Ads that reach families near {place}
steps.text: In the first week we set up ads for {home}. We write the ad scripts and edit the videos. The families who reach out are only yours.

steps.title: A reason for families to act now
steps.text: We build an offer for {home} with a deadline, so families decide sooner. The ads ask a few plain questions first, so you talk to families who can pay.

steps.title: Every family gets a fast answer
steps.text: When a family reaches out, they get a text from your own number right away. Each morning you get a list of who to call, with the texts already written.

timeline: Setup takes about a week. The 90 days start when the ads go live.
try_title: One thing you can try this week
try_this_week: Have a friend call {home} about a room in the evening. See how long it takes to hear back.
facts_note: Facts about your home come from the pages linked here.
